newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIA'S ALMAZ HAS NO COMMENT ON PGM DELIVERIES.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIA'S ALMAZ HAS NO COMMENT ON PGM DELIVERIES.

text.p: Russia's Almazjuvelirexport kept silent on Friday over its schedule for delivering precious metals to Japan, declining to provide any information on supplies of platinum and palladium.

Employees at the offices of senior Almaz officials Vitaly Berlin and Sergei Gorny said the men had ordered that no information be provided about deliveries, adding that both officials were out of Russia on business trips.
Japanese traders said earlier on Friday that deliveries of Russian platinum and palladium for August under long-term contracts had arrived in Japan that morning.

Russia, which supplies more than 60 percent of the world's palladium and about 20 percent of its platinum, first resumed PGM shipments to Japan under long-term contracts in July after a six-month suspension.
The sketchy deliveries have fuelled worries about supply.
